title: Validation of two Questionnaires - Eating Behaviours of Children
summary: Evaluation of two questionnaires assessing eating behaviors in children with different psychological diagnoses.
conditions: Eating Behavior of children with autism and other psychological diagnoses

interventions.name:
Parents of children with autism spectrum disorder fill out questionnaires about the eating behaviors of their child one time. There are five Questionnaires: 
1. "PARDI- AR-Q: Parent 4+" 2. "AEQ" 3. "SRS-16" 4. "RBS-R" 5. "CBCL 4-18"

Parents of children with internalizing/ externalizing disorders fill out questionnaires about the eating behaviors of their child one time. There are five Questionnaires: 
1. "PARDI- AR-Q: Parent 4+" 2. "AEQ" 3. "SRS-16" 4. "RBS-R" 5. "CBCL 4-18"

Parents of typically neurodeveloping children fill out questionnaires about the eating behaviors of their child one time. There are five Questionnaires: 
1. "PARDI- AR-Q: Parent 4+" 2. "AEQ" 3. "SRS-16" 4. "RBS-R" 5. "CBCL 4-18"

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Parents have sufficient German language skills to understand and complete the questionnaires.
Group 1: Children with a diagnosis of Autism Spectrum Disorder (ASD)
Group 2: Children with internalizing or externalizing psychiatric disorders
Group 3: Control group without any psychiatric diagnoses
Exclusion criteria:
The child or adolescent must not currently be receiving outpatient, day-patient, or inpatient child and adolescent psychiatric treatment due to an eating disorder such as Anorexia Nervosa or Bulimia Nervosa, nor have received such a diagnosis in the past.
Furthermore, children or adolescents meeting the inclusion criteria must not be diagnosed with any of the following psychiatric disorders according to ICD-10:
F0: Organic mental disorders
F1: Mental and behavioral disorders due to psychoactive substance use
F2: Schizophrenia, schizotypal, and delusional disorders
F30: Manic episode
F31: Bipolar affective disorder
F34.0: Cyclothymia
F42: Obsessive-compulsive disorder
F43: Reaction to severe stress and adjustment disorders
F44: Dissociative disorders
F45: Somatoform disorders
F48: Other neurotic disorders
F6: Personality and behavioral disorders
